name: Oleg the Wise
role: Varangian prince, founder of Kievan Rus'
contribution: A Varangian prince of the Rus' who became prince of Kiev, and laid the foundations of the Kievan Rus' state.

checks.lead: Oleg (Old East Slavic: Ѡлегъ, romanised: Ōlegǔ, Ольгъ, Olǐgǔ; Old Norse: Helgi; died 912), also known as Oleg the Wise, was a Varangian prince of the Rus' who became prince of Kiev, and laid the foundations of the Kievan Rus' state.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
